_readme: MISSION BRIEFS — the narrated screen the player sees after a chapter's intro film.
Founders edit this file. One entry per chapter id (ch1…ch6); a chapter with no entry
simply skips the brief screen and goes straight into the conversation.
'lines' are spoken and typed onto the black screen one at a time, in order.
Keep each line one short sentence — it has to land on its own.
'accept' is the wording on the button at the end (defaults to 'I ACCEPT').
After editing, run:  npm run build:briefs
That regenerates ONLY the lines whose wording changed and saves them under
public/audio/brief/. The game never calls ElevenLabs while it is running.

lines: Your objective: understand how one treaty set the world on fire.
Learn what the Treaty of Versailles demanded of Germany.
Learn how those terms broke a nation, and left its people desperate.
Learn how that desperation carried Adolf Hitler to power.
And learn how it ended — with German tanks crossing into Poland.
Your objective: understand the summer Britain stood alone.
Learn how the army escaped at Dunkirk, and how France fell.
Learn why Germany had to destroy the RAF before it could invade.
Learn how radar and fewer than three thousand pilots held the line.
And learn how the bombers turned on London — and were beaten back.
Your objective: understand how the war became the whole world's war.
Learn why Japan struck at America across the Pacific.
Learn what happened at Pearl Harbor on the seventh of December.
Learn how America answered — and how Germany answered America.
And learn how separate wars became one world war.
